## DEC-7 — AddressDropdown Hyvä migration: chọn Strategy B (full Hyvä-native)

- **Date**: 2026-07-16 (Accepted 2026-07-16)
- **Status**: Accepted — approved via `/approve` by user acting as SA/TL decision authority (Level 2)
- **Decided option**: Strategy B (full Hyvä-native — Alpine.js + Magewire + `.phtml` + Tailwind v4)
- **Deciders**: user (chat) acting as SA/TL authority — formal SA/TL name [TBD]
- **Context**: Ticket [TASK-88NDV5](../../tickets/TASK-88NDV5-apply-hyva-theme-addressdropdown.md) yêu cầu apply Hyvä cho `Secomm_AddressDropdown`. Module hiện là Luma/Knockout/RequireJS thuần → không render trên storefront Hyvä. OSC (checkout thật) là Knockout-based chạy qua compat `hyva-themes/magento2-luma-checkout`. Có 2 strategy:
  - (A) Storefront rewrite sang Hyvä + giữ Knockout trong checkout-region qua compat layer, chỉ sửa OSC component target.
  - (B) **Full Hyvä-native** (Alpine.js + Magewire + `.phtml` + Tailwind v4) cho **mọi address surface incl. OSC**.
- **Decision**: Chọn **Strategy B** — render hierarchical VN address dropdown Hyvä-native trên cả customer address form, cart estimation, và Mageplaza OSC (shipping + billing). Backend (`Api/`/`Model`/`Setup`/import/admin) giữ nguyên; tái dùng GraphQL sẵn có (`GetListCity`/`GetListSubCity`) + core Magento GraphQL (Country/Region).
- **Rationale**: Nhất quán hoàn toàn với theme Hyvä (BR-001/BR-002), tránh phụ thuộc dài hạn vào compat layer luma-checkout (kỹ thuật trung gian, dễ vỡ khi upgrade), giảm bề mặt Knockout/RequireJS trên storefront. Magewire là preferred cho stateful form (address dropdown) theo AGENTS.md §7.2.
- **Consequences**:
  - (+) Frontend nhất quán Hyvä; dễ maintain; không phụ thuộc compat layer.
  - (−) Effort cao hơn (estimate ~32–56h vs ~16–24h cho A); chạm OSC (Tier 2) nhiều hơn → rủi ro checkout/payment regression.
  - (−) Phải giải OSC address seam + submit mechanism (Open Questions Q2/Q3 trong spec).
  - Follow-up: đánh giá undeprecate + cache GraphQL resolver (Q1); QC end-to-end checkout + payment bắt buộc.
- **Related**: [TASK-88NDV5](../../tickets/TASK-88NDV5-apply-hyva-theme-addressdropdown.md) · [spec addressdropdown-hyva](../../specs/addressdropdown-hyva.md) · `project-context/10_CHECKOUT_PAYMENT_SHIPPING_ORDER_FLOW.md` · AGENTS.md §7.2, §12 (high-risk)

## DEC-8 — Reusability boundary: Secomm_AddressDropdown (module) vs Launchpad (project) — refine DEC-7

- **Date**: 2026-07-16 (Accepted 2026-07-16)
- **Status**: Accepted — approved via `/approve` by user acting as SA/TL decision authority (Level 2)
- **Decided option**: module owns generic surfaces only (no OSC/Ahamave coupling); OSC integration → Launchpad package (TASK-FMAN1B)
- **Deciders**: user (chat) acting as SA/TL authority — formal SA/TL name [TBD]
- **Context**: `Secomm_AddressDropdown` là module **tái dụng (reusable)**. DEC-7 (Strategy B) ban đầu gộp cả OSC integration vào module — vi phạm nguyên tắc tách biệt: module tái dụng không được coupling với `Mageplaza OSC` (third-party, choice theo project) hay `Secomm_Ahamave` (project-specific shipping). Thực tế `view/frontend/requirejs-config.js` đang reference `Secomm_Ahamave/...` = **project-leak** vào module tái dụng.
- **Decision**:
  - **Module (`Secomm_AddressDropdown`)** chỉ sở hữu **generic Magento-native surfaces**: customer address form, cart shipping estimation, default/Luma checkout. Module có thể hỗ trợ Hyvä (template Tailwind/Alpine/Magewire của chính nó) vì Hyvä là theme, không phải third-party.
  - **OSC customization** (wiring address dropdown vào Mageplaza OSC) phải nằm trong **package Launchpad** (project layer: `app/design/frontend/Secomm/launchpad/` + code project-owned) → **ticket riêng TASK-FMAN1B**.
  - Module **không reference** `Mageplaza_Osc` hay `Secomm_Ahamave`. Remove dead ref Ahamave hiện có.
- **Rationale**: Giữ module tái dụng portable (deploy cho client khác không có OSC/Ahamove vẫn chạy surface generic); tách concern reusable vs project-specific; OSC là decision của project này (BR-004), không phải dependency của module.
- **Consequences**:
  - (+) Module sạch, tái dụng được; OSC risk (Tier 2 checkout/payment) cô lập trong TASK-FMAN1B/Launchpad.
  - (−) Work split thành 2 ticket: TASK-88NDV5 (module) + TASK-FMAN1B (Launchpad OSC); TASK-FMAN1B phụ thuộc TASK-88NDV5 (module phải expose Hyvä component/dữ liệu để Launchpad wire vào OSC).
  - Refines DEC-7: phần "render dropdown trên OSC" trong DEC-7 không do module làm — chuyển sang TASK-FMAN1B (Launchpad). DEC-7 (Strategy B — Hyvä-native) vẫn valid cho cả 2 ticket.
- **Related**: refines [DEC-7](#dec-7) · [TASK-88NDV5](../../tickets/TASK-88NDV5-apply-hyva-theme-addressdropdown.md) · [TASK-FMAN1B](../../tickets/TASK-FMAN1B-launchpad-osc-address-integration.md) · [spec addressdropdown-hyva](../../specs/addressdropdown-hyva.md)

## DEC-9 — Dual-theme support (Luma + Hyva) cho reusable module — refines DEC-7

- **Date**: 2026-07-17
- **Status**: Accepted — user-directed (approved plan)
- **Decided option**: module theme-agnostic (both Luma native + Hyva native); theme switch qua `hyva_` layout handle
- **Deciders**: user (chat) acting as SA/TL authority — formal SA/TL name [TBD]
- **Context**: DEC-7 (Strategy B) hướng tới Hyvä-native; TASK-88NDV5 implement rewrite customer form **Hyva-only** + xóa Luma JS (`address-dropdown.js`, cart mixin) → **Luma bị hỏng**. Nhưng `Secomm_AddressDropdown` là module **reusable generic** (DEC-8) → phải hỗ trợ BOTH Luma (native jQuery/Knockout) VÀ Hyva (native Alpine) để ship cho client project trên mỗi stack.
- **Decision**:
  - Module **theme-agnostic** — hỗ trợ cả Luma + Hyva trên toàn bộ storefront (customer form + cart + default checkout).
  - Templates nằm trong **module** (portable). Customer form theme switch qua **`hyva_` layout handle** (Hyva auto-add qua `Hyva\Theme\Observer\AddLayoutHandles`): `customer_address_form.xml` (Luma, `setTemplate → edit.phtml`) + `hyva_customer_address_form.xml` (Hyva, `setTemplate → hyva/address/edit.phtml`), cả hai `ifconfig="address/general/enable"`.
  - Cart: Luma layout (`checkout_cart_index.xml` Knockout jsLayout) **inert trên Hyva** (php-cart native, region-based). Default checkout: Luma layout (`checkout_index_index.xml`) inert trên Hyva/OSC.
  - **Không PHP theme detection** — bỏ Block preference + `Block\Customer\Address\Edit` + `Helper\Theme` (core block `getTemplate` trả layout-set template).
- **Rationale**: `hyva_` handle = pattern Hyva khuyên dùng (declarative, zero-PHP, FPC-safe). Portable — không hard-depend `Hyva_Theme` (module chạy trên Luma-only client). `ifconfig` trên `<action>` gate module-enable (locked bởi Magento `BlockTest.php`). Module ship được cho client Luma hoặc Hyva.
- **Consequences**:
  - (+) Module reusable, cả 2 theme native; cơ chế sạch (layout handle, không PHP detection).
  - (−) Luma path **không test được** trên project Hyva-only này → QC cần Luma theme/client riêng.
  - Refines DEC-7: "Hyva-native" → "dual Luma + Hyva". DEC-8 (boundary generic/OSC) vẫn valid.
  - Follow-up: default-checkout Luma JS VN-hardcoding (`shipping-address-dropdown.js:160-170`) → align i18n (riêng).
- **Related**: refines [DEC-7](#dec-7) · [DEC-8](#dec-8) · [TASK-88NDV5](../../tickets/TASK-88NDV5-apply-hyva-theme-addressdropdown.md) · [spec addressdropdown-hyva](../../specs/addressdropdown-hyva.md) · plan `v-i-secomm-addressdropdown-y-l-merry-parrot.md`

- [DEC-FEATYA2C0W-004](../../records/decisions/DEC-FEATYA2C0W-004.md) — Vietnam address/shipping dependency chain + ownership: AddressDropdown → VietNamAddress → ShippingCore → carriers; ShippingCore consume VietNamAddress contracts (supersede MỘT PHẦN DEC-TASKNDASAD-001 stance "carrier tự normalize"); carrier API profile bundle (atomic switch); operational↔canonical bridge (name-entry tạm: AMBIGUOUS, không first-match); DirectoryReferenceGuard DI extension thay hardcode carrier tables; GHN mapping merge về GiaoHangNhanh (supersede MỘT PHẦN DEC-TASK3F6QWZ-001); scheme swap unsafe tới khi mapping + saved addresses scheme-aware; reuse secomm_vietnam_address_unit, không new abstraction (accepted 2026-09-03 — user acting as SA/TL; work_items: FEAT-YA2C0W, TASK-9394A9, TASK-J9AVGK, TASK-3F6QWZ)

- [DEC-BUG4WYXCB-002](../../records/decisions/DEC-BUG4WYXCB-002.md) — VNPAY minimal fix (supersedes DEC-BUG4WYXCB-001 quote-based intent): order-first nhưng `pending_payment` qua `_isInitializeNeeded`+`initialize()`, cron core `sales_clean_orders` auto-cancel sau `delete_pending_after` (30-60p); fix kèm Ipn guard/catch/setTotalPaid/CAPTURE_OFFLINE + OrderSender email chỉ khi paid; 3 file, không module mới, không đụng JS (accepted 2026-09-08 — user acting as SA/TL in chat; work_items: BUG-4WYXCB)
- [DEC-BUG4WYXCB-003](../../records/decisions/DEC-BUG4WYXCB-003.md) — VNPAY quote-based intent CHỐT CUỐI (supersedes DEC-002): order chỉ tạo sau khi VNPAY xác nhận thành công; inline trong 6 file có sẵn (Info intent session-based / Ipn SSOT / Pay fallback / JS bỏ place-order / vnpay.php chặn email / en_US.csv), KHÔNG file mới, KHÔNG email gì cả; vnp_TxnRef per-attempt trên additional_information; fix kèm các defect Ipn (accepted 2026-09-08 — user acting as SA/TL in chat; work_items: BUG-4WYXCB)
- [DEC-BUG4WYXCB-005](../../records/decisions/DEC-BUG4WYXCB-005.md) — VNPAY quote-based intent OWNER IMPLEMENT (supersedes DEC-003): Info tạo attempt trên quote (vnp_TxnRef = reserved_order_id, không vnp_ExpireDate sau sự cố code=15 timezone); Ipn/Pay placeOrder từ quote sau khi VNPAY xác nhận; JS setPaymentInformationAction; chặn email qua vnpay.php order(); 7 risks liệt kê cho TL review; rename Secomm_VNPAY 2026-09-09, file mồ côi đã xóa (accepted 2026-09-08, updated 2026-09-09 — owner implement; work_items: BUG-4WYXCB)

- [DEC-FEATZLP1PF-002](../../records/decisions/DEC-FEATZLP1PF-002.md) — ZaloPay payment-first Blocker 2: OrderFinalizer::finalizeOrRecover là single owner của 5 success-session Last* keys — controller short-circuit bị bỏ; FINALIZED duplicate rebuild session idempotent (proposed — chờ TL re-review; work_items: FEAT-ZLP1PF)
- [DEC-FEATZLP1PF-003](../../records/decisions/DEC-FEATZLP1PF-003.md) — ZaloPay finalization dùng MỘT flattened DB transaction (Mysql adapter verified: nested begin/commit là counter, không savepoints); không state trung gian ORDER_CREATED; capture ở trong TX — capture fail rollback cả order, attempt về PAID (proposed — chờ TL re-review; work_items: FEAT-ZLP1PF)

- [DEC-TASKZR2ZNS-002](../../records/decisions/DEC-TASKZR2ZNS-002.md) — POS adapter convention (final 2026-09-11): Core + Secomm_Pancake (vendor logic) + Secomm_PancakeBridge (wiring), KHÔNG tách module Function riêng — PancakeFunction thành disabled stub; dependency một chiều Bridge → Pancake → Core, Pancake không reference Bridge; BC config path/service_code/CLI; supersedes DEC-TASKZR2ZNS-001 (proposed — chờ TL approve; work_items: TASK-ZR2ZNS, mirror SLP-30 CONV/FNC/BRG/MIG-001/MIG-002)
- [DEC-FEATFQWEQ3-001](../../records/decisions/DEC-FEATFQWEQ3-001.md) — Secomm_Ghn Create Order dual-scheme: payload dùng `is_new_to_address=true` + `to_province_name`/`to_ward_name` từ mapping `VN_ADMIN_2025 → GHN_ADMIN_2025` (KHÔNG legacy IDs cho create); rating giữ nguyên PRE_2025 → legacy `district_id`+`ward_code`; sync master data + mapping cả 2 scheme; GATE: staging evidence `is_new_to_address` với ward đã merge TRƯỚC khi code GHN-D (TASK-9Q5ZAK); supersede MỘT PHẦN conclusion create-old-style của SPIKE-9Z231Q clarification v3 (accepted 2026-09-10 — user acting as SA/TL; work_items: FEAT-FQWEQ3, TASK-9Q5ZAK)
- [DEC-FEATFQWEQ3-002](../../records/decisions/DEC-FEATFQWEQ3-002.md) — Secomm_Ghn mapping lifecycle: versioned export → offline reviewed mapping → import/bootstrap; KHÔNG cơ chế nào tự tạo APPROVED (exact/normalized name, extension_names, fuzzy, curated alias chỉ là candidate-generation/audit tooling); module ship bundled reviewed dataset `data/` + manifest (first-install không cần GHN API); portable identity scheme+unit_code ↔ scheme+provider_key (cấm entity_id/region_id/city_id trong file); import APPROVED-only fail-loud UPSERT không truncate; sync master ≠ activation mapping; MappingGenerator xóa → MappingSuggester workfile; supersede MỘT PHẦN SPEC-FEAT-FQWEQ3 §7 (accepted 2026-09-10 — user directive; work_items: FEAT-FQWEQ3, TASK-TBM30R)
- [DEC-TASK7AJ3K8-001](../../records/decisions/DEC-TASK7AJ3K8-001.md) — GHTK alignment amendments: shared HTTP primitive vào NGAY (siết D10 một phần — client+DTO+6 error categories+retry; auth/payload vẫn carrier; create-order no auto-retry); secomm_ghtk_address_map = GHTK name alias map chính thức, giữ runtime key, lookup chỉ qua reverse bridge (D6 re-key hoãn follow-up DB riêng); name-bridge sibling contract (freeze VnOperationalAddressResolverInterface, statuses reuse VnAddressResolutionInterface, match vi+en); GHTK textual-fallback semantics (AMBIGUOUS → không gửi request — bỏ first-match; UNMAPPED → province name_vi + submitted ward); origin ward = locality-slot convention, hoãn canonical origin enrichment until consumer (accepted 2026-09-10 — user acting as SA/TL, Tier-2 review trước merge; work_items: TASK-7AJ3K8)
- [DEC-TASK7AJ3K8-002](../../records/decisions/DEC-TASK7AJ3K8-002.md) — GHTK address mode TEXT_NATIVE: canonical name_vi = default representation (VnAddressUnitProvider); secomm_ghtk_address_map hạ cấp exception/override table (canonical key scheme+province+ward, overrides nullable, drop runtime ids — khắc phục D6; DirectoryReferenceGuard xoá; setup:upgrade bắt buộc); bỏ textual-fallback guess (AMBIGUOUS/UNMAPPED → hide, supportsTextualFallback=false); một adapter duy nhất GhtkAddressAdapter cho destination+pickup (pick_address_id vẫn ưu tiên); import CSV exception-rows + validator canonical qua VietNamAddress contracts; supersede MỘT PHẦN DEC-TASK7AJ3K8-001 Decision 2+4 (accepted 2026-09-10 — user acting as SA/TL; work_items: TASK-7AJ3K8)- [DEC-TASKBE5YD2-001](../../records/decisions/DEC-TASKBE5YD2-001.md) — GHTK ORDER_ID_EXIST = RECOVERED_EXISTING sau identity validation (parsed.partner_id === submitted order.id + có ghtk_label → reuse provider identity cho native shipment, KHÔNG submit lại/không shipment thứ hai); mismatch/missing partner_id/missing label → hard business conflict fail-closed; CREATE vẫn single attempt không blind POST retry — uncertain timeout → merchant retry CÙNG deterministic order.id đi vào recovery (idempotency role của order.id); exact runtime response shape NEEDS_RUNTIME_VERIFICATION (parser defensive top-level+order block); thay rejection behavior era SL-016 (accepted 2026-09-14 — user acting as SA/TL; work_items: TASK-BE5YD2)
- [DEC-TASK9Q5ZAK-001](../../records/decisions/DEC-TASK9Q5ZAK-001.md) — Physical shipment facts layer: ShippingCore owns carrier-neutral facts (`Api/Physical/` PhysicalPackage/ShipmentPhysicalData/CarrierPhysicalLimit — grams/cm int, facts-only, không carrier semantics); storage = `sales_shipment.packages` marker `secomm_physical` (Magento-native, 0 bảng mới, label-flow mutually exclusive); merchant default dims = `secomm_shippingcore/physical/*` PREFILL-only (di chuyển khỏi `carriers/secomm_ghn/parcel_*`, không bao giờ auto-inject — thiếu final data fail-closed INVALID_PARCEL); GHN interpret: 1 pkg <20,000g → type 2 root, else type 5 items[] = 1 GHN item/physical package ("Package N", qty 1, exact values), root weight = Σ factual, dims = largest-by-volume; multi-package = 1 Shipment → N pkg → 1 GHN order; limits carrier-owned 50,000g/200cm; RATE type-5 giữ backlog (option A — checkout chưa có confirmed physical facts) (proposed 2026-09-15 — TL accept tại r2 review; work_items: TASK-9Q5ZAK)
- [DEC-TASK5XQXZK-001](../../records/decisions/DEC-TASK5XQXZK-001.md) — Mageplaza TableRate fallback: Magento làm carrier orchestrator (KHÔNG fan-out registry); ShippingCore `CarrierRateOutcomeCollectorInterface` (pair carrier_code+method_code, per-collection isolation); carriers chỉ report (thêm reasons CANONICAL_AMBIGUOUS/CANONICAL_UNMAPPED/INVALID_CONFIGURATION); safe-degradation eligibility policy ShippingCore-owned (TECHNICAL_FAILURE + CANONICAL_AMBIGUOUS eligible; UNMAPPED/config/unsupported NOT); Mageplaza Method = fallback grouping identity (per-method show_to_customer/use_as_fallback/membership pair-identity, extension tables CASCADE); outer seam plugin `Shipping::collectRates`; KHÔNG auto-hide members; city dimension stable `city_code` precedence 3-tier zero-regression; deprecate global mode + service_level mapping (accepted 2026-09-15 — user acting as SA/TL; work_items: FEAT-GGTWXW, TASK-5XQXZK)
